webpage.text:
Spago restaurant review

Spago Maui is the Austrian-American celebrity chef and restaurateur Wolfgang Puck’s Hawaiian fine dining restaurant located in Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea. Wolfgang Puck will not cook anything for you, but his famous fusion techniques show clearly in the cuisine with a Californian and Hawaiian mix.

Casual dress code and mostly American mainland tourists are what to expect when you arrive at the busy indoor seating for up to 135 guests, but you can have private dining for around 80 of your friends or business associates as well. The style is more tropical compared to Wolfgang Puck’s Los Angeles venues and it is busy, busy, busy at least if you are having your dinner during peak season. None of us who has been to the restaurant has been seated right away but has been forced to spend up to 45 minutes waiting for the table. That is far from okay for any restaurant that calls itself a fine dining restaurant.

We have had some really bad experiences of the restaurant, with everything from the ordered meat served completely overdone even if it was requested as medium rare, being served cold food when it was supposed to be hot, impolite waiters with lack of knowledge of the cuisine served, a missing sommelier and to have no table at all despite the fact that it was confirmed both on email and by the hotel’s concierge. That incident was solved by the restaurant by adding a temporary tiny table in the aisle, resulting in people constantly walking into it.

Luckily our inspectors and the guests we have talked with have had better experiences, but none of them close to being completely satisfied. It seems to be more than a consistency problem, but that can only the restaurant’s management answer to. We got the uncomfortable feeling that Spago Maui does not care. They are fully booked anyway and the majority of the vacation celebrating clientele does not seem to bother either. The dinner experience of the Spago Maui gets better if you lower your expectations, put on a Hawaiian shirt and take it for what it is – a typical resort’s way of using a famous chef’s name and cash in on that.

Wolfgang Puck has certainly been involved in creating the menu, and courses like the grilled Hawaiian monchong and the Hawaiian opakapaka steamed in ti leave, among several others that are offered, are a tasty and clever way of fusion cuisine.

Images courtesy of Spago Maui

Written by Andy

webpage.text:
Luxury Resorts in Hawaii | Hawaii Vacation

Embrace the spirit of aloha with our Hawaii Collection where you will experience deep-rooted connections to land and sea. Each of our unique destinations provides a gateway to your own authentic journey.

 * FOUR SEASONS RESORT MAUI
   
   Discover the beauty of Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea. Let the stunning scenery of our open-air beachfront resort stimulate your senses as you explore the rich culture and natural beauty.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * ACCOMMODATIONS AT MAUI
   
   Settle into a spacious, private room or suite with an idyllic view of Wailea Beach and the Hawaiian islands beyond. All of our Maui at Wailea accommodations offer top-rate amenities and services ideal for individual guests, couples or families.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * EXPERIENCE MAUI
   
   Witness the migration of the majestic humpback whales, sip award-winning Hawaiian coffee on a private farm tour, or connect with our Four Seasons Maui at Wailea concierge team and tailor a once-in-a-lifetime day trip that you’ll never forget.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * DINING AT MAUI
   
   Our master chefs find their inspiration in orchestrating an indelible dining experience. Enjoy locally-inspired fusion cuisine at Master Chef Wolfgang Puck’s Spago, and savour handcrafted cocktails while looking out over breathtaking panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * RELAXATION AT MAUI
   
   Lose yourself in oceanside bliss and savour cool tropical breezes with a massage in one of our traditional open-air treatment huts overlooking spectacular views of Wailea Beach.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * FOUR SEASONS RESORT HUALALAI
   
   The spirit of Hawaii shines brightly at Four Seasons Resort Hualalai. Nestled between pristine beaches and volcanic landscapes, this island sanctuary offers dedicated service to enhance every moment of your once-in-a-lifetime experience.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * ACCOMMODATIONS AT HUALALAI
   
   Every villa, suite or room opens up to an incredible view and offers amenities that add a special touch to your private tropical paradise. Whether you’re planning an unforgettable family getaway or a romantic escape, Four Seasons Hualalai can exceed all your expectations.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * EXPERIENCE HUALALAI
   
   Take in a magnificent helicopter-view of ancient volcanoes, explore hidden beaches lined with turquoise waters, and dine under the starry night sky. The awe-inspiring island of Hualalai will fill your sense of adventure.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * DINING AT HUALALAI
   
   Spoil yourself with culinary choices. Whether you start the day with our signature Moco Loco breakfast dish or enjoy artisanal cuisine under a starlit backdrop, our team of world-class chefs delight in every opportunity to elevate your senses.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * RELAXATION AT HUALALAI
   
   Master the art of rest and relaxation at one of our outdoor spas draped in tropical greenery, or book a consultation with one of our apothecary experts and receive a reinvigorating bespoke skin treatment made from local ingredients.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * FOUR SEASONS RESORT LANAI
   
   Whether you’re soaking up the sun’s warmth by our lagoon-style pools, admiring the beauty of our botanical gardens, or pampering yourself at our Hawanawana Spa, you’ll delight in discovering the secluded tropical paradise at Four Seasons Resort Lanai.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * ACCOMMODATIONS AT LANAI
   
   From Specialty Suites to Four Seasons Suites, your accommodation options are abundant. Each space is filled with thoughtful design and decor inspired by local culture and natural resources, creating a distinct motif only found on the islands of Hawaii.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * EXPERIENCE LANAI
   
   Discover the road less travelled in a 4x4 Jeep, explore the seas in a 65-foot catamaran, or tee off at our Jack Nicklaus-designed Manele Golf Course. The island is yours to explore at Four Seasons Resort Lanai.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * DINING AT LANAI
   
   Immerse yourself in culinary bliss at Nobu Lanai, or celebrate Chef Nancy Silverton’s traditional Italian cuisine at Osteria Mozza. If you’re curious about the art of making poke, you can join us on an exciting fishing excursion and learn from the experts.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * RELAXATION AT LANAI
   
   Experience therapies and treatments inspired by the island, including the Ti Leaf Relief Session or Lanai Honey Escape, complemented by diverse wellness classes in beautiful settings.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * FOUR SEASONS RESORT OAHU
   
   Let your curiosity lead the way at Four Seasons Resort Oahu Ko Olina. Our beachfront island Resort is situated in the heart of the rugged western coast, with ocean views as far as the eye can see. Listen closely, the experience of a lifetime is calling your name.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * ACCOMMODATIONS AT OAHU
   
   From our Oceanfront Junior Suite to the Penthouse, every accommodation at Four Seasons Oahu is crafted for your comfort and designed with sophistication. Start each day in an airy, private space that is just moments away from idyllic beaches and exhilarating activities.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * EXPERIENCE OAHU
   
   Choose from a curated selection of extraordinary outdoor activities, designed for the adventurous at heart. Unique experiences include the infamous Warbird flight, hiking trails and sailing excursions.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * DINING AT OAHU
   
   Start your day with our famed Sunday Brunch For All Seasons buffet at La Hiki. Indulge in an unforgettable culinary journey with a Fish Sommelier Dinner at Mina’s Fish House, where a meticulously crafted five-course meal awaits. Savour the rich flavours of Southern Italian cuisine at Noe, or delight in the vibrant fusion of cultures at Manalo Lounge.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * RELAXATION AT OAHU
   
   Transform your body and mind with a traditional Naupaka Lomilomi Massage or a Hulali Hawaiian Healing Facial. Reset and reconnect with a guided sound bath experience to reduce stress, quiet the mind, ease anxiety and restore energetic balance.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * SENSEI LANAI, A FOUR SEASONS RESORT
   
   Grow well, thrive and flourish at our wellness sanctuary amongst rolling hills, tropical greenery and unimaginable natural beauty. Immerse yourself in programs and services designed to guide you towards healthier living practices.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * ACCOMMODATIONS AT SENSEI LANAI
   
   Bask in the best of true indoor-outdoor living with the sun on your skin and fresh air flowing freely. All of our spacious, private rooms were designed to fill with natural light and look out onto landscapes so gorgeous, they could only be found in Hawaii.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * YOUR JOURNEY TO WELL-BEING
   
   Your personal Sensei Guide will help craft an itinerary including spa treatments, guided sessions, classes and island activities to achieve the wellness goals most important to you.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * DINING AT SENSEI LANAI
   
   Sensei Lanai has partnered with celebrated chef and restaurateur Nobu Matsuhisa to bring you Sensei by Nobu, an unparalleled culinary experience inspired by the bounty of nature and a philosophy of nourishment.
   
   LEARN MORE

 * EXPERIENCE LANAI
   
   Revel in the rustic beauty of the Lanai countryside on one of our horseback riding trips. Or discover underwater worlds on a snorkeling excursion. Sensei Lanai is always ready to reveal your next great adventure.
   
   LEARN MORE


Experiences & Activities


GET INSPIRED FROM SUNRISE TO SUNSET

 * VistaJet
   
   
   Private Travel to Hawaii
   
   Gain access to VistaJet’s private aircraft with special Four Seasons Hawaii rates, and enjoy a safe, customized air travel experience to the islands.

 * Culture
   
   
   TRADITION THAT MOVES YOU
   
   It’s more than the landscape that makes Hawaii so irresistible; it’s the culture based on love and community you’ll find at Four Seasons.

 * Family
   
   
   SOMETHING FOR EVERYONE
   
   Hawaii is a playground for all ages. Spy humpback whales splashing through Auau Channel, learn the hula, go stargazing at Mauna Kea and much more.

 * Golf
   
   
   NATURAL BEAUTY IS PAR FOR THE COURSE
   
   Play on some of Hawaii’s best courses at Four Seasons. Tee off on fairways set against dramatic black lava at the Jack Nicklaus–designed Hualalai Golf Course or Manele Golf Course.

 * Couples
   
   
   FALL IN LOVE ALL OVER AGAIN
   
   Magical moments are around every corner at Four Seasons. Book private spa treatments, day trips, or gazebos for you and your special someone.

 * Wellness
   
   
   FOR BODY AND SOUL
   
   In Hawaii, tuning in to mana ‘aina – the spirit of the land – is an essential part of life. Our experts can help guide you through these nature-inspired treatments.

 * Private Suites at LAX
   
   
   STRESS-FREE COMMUTE
   
   Book a suite at a Four Seasons Hawaii resort and enjoy a luxurious and relaxing way to travel via Private Suites at Los Angeles International Airport (PS LAX). (Terms and conditions apply. This benefit does not apply to guests of Four Seasons Resort Lanai or Sensei, A Four Seasons Resort.)


DISCOVER THE SPIRIT OF ALOHA WITH US


 * HUALALAI
   
   You’ll find oceanfront splendour in perfect harmony with nature
   
   LEARN MORE


 * MAUI AT WAILEA
   
   Get out or hide away on the island’s most sun-filled coast
   
   LEARN MORE


 * LANAI
   
   A secluded oceanfront retreat on Hawaii’s last unspoiled island
   
   LEARN MORE


 * OAHU AT KO OLINA
   
   Experience laid-back luxury on Oahu’s sunny western coast
   
   LEARN MORE


 * SENSEI LANAI
   
   Discover an oasis of tranquillity on this hidden Hawaiian island
   
   LEARN MORE

webpage.text:
Escape to Paradise at Hyatt Regency Trinidad

Considering your next vacation? Jaw-dropping views, creative décor and some of the finest food the Caribbean offers can be yours at the Hyatt Regency Trinidad.

From being designated as having one of the “coolest Caribbean hotel lobby bars” by USA Today to employing an executive chef who turns street food into elegant dishes, the wow factor goes far at the Hyatt Regency Trinidad.

Inside, the hotel boasts bright, tropical-inspired furnishings and eye-catching lighting. Outside, an ocean view provides the ideal Caribbean backdrop.


Executive Chef Fernando Franco creates an indulgent menu, with items such as Mini Bake n Shark Skewers—presented with tamarind, pineapple chutney and other sauces—showing off his creativity. Born in Argentina, Chef Franco has been using his love for food and his dedication to his craft to produce memorable and tasty meals with his talented team in downtown Port of Spain for more than eight years. His career spans nearly three decades of innovative culinary creations with inspiration drawn from multiple countries, including Spain, Portugal, Italy, Brazil, Chile, Uruguay and Hawaii.

Take a seat at hotel bar, relax and enjoy sweeping views of the Gulf of Paria. Fresh and fruity tropical drinks include Chutney Rhythm, Trini Woman and other cocktails crafted with Angostura Rum, which is made just down the road.

A long cold winter is ahead. Now is the perfect time to plan a getaway! Learn out more about the Hyatt Regency Trinidad on the hotel website.

The Hyatt Regency Trinidad is located at #1 Wrightson Rd., Port-of-Spain, Republic of Trinidad & Tobago; phone: 1-868-623-2222.
